properties.q_0_substrate_before_form: Before S1 can be the material container it presupposes the executable ground it is written upon — S0's filesystem and process plane (S0.md: 'Hen actualises S0 as the file and template substrate required for vault life'). As the S-family's manifestation of the raw #1 archetype (Definition/Form, CLAUDE.md II.A), S1's own ground is the prior 0 it does not contain: the bare bytes-on-disk that carry no residency, no frontmatter, no coordinate — a markdown file is, at S0, just a stream that persists. S1's void-pole is the unformed material: a folder before it is a context, a note before it bears identity, a link before it resolves to a relation. This is the thrown givenness S1 stands upon — that there is a filesystem willing to hold ordered text, prior to any law about what that order MEANS. The horizon here is not S1's own but S0's beneath it: the raw persistence that S1 will discipline into 'durable markdown memory, ontological residency, and durable vault law' (S1.md) but which it inherits rather than authors. Before residency, the substrate that consented to bear it; before the file IS the thing, the file is merely a file. S1's q_0 is the material plenum handed up from execution, awaiting the formal law that will make bytes into Bimba.
properties.q_1_material_container: S1 IS the Material Container — 'the layer where the system becomes materially resident … the vault as form-bearing memory: markdown files, YAML frontmatter, [[wikilinks]], canvas artifacts, folder hierarchies, and a residency law that distinguishes canon from process, invocation from archive, and enduring ontology from temporal work' (S1.md). This is S1's home register and its essential thesis: where S0 makes the system executable, S1 makes it RESIDENT AND TYPED. Its substance is the explicit filesystem law (S1.md): Idea/Bimba/World is the flat canonical form library; World/Types is the ordered ontology and MOC workspace where forms are born, refined, and indexed before graduation; Idea/Empty/Present is the temporal basin of active invocation (Day and NOW); Idea/Pratibimba is the reflective and archival afterlife. Its residency is Body/S/S1/hen-compiler-core, with Hen (S4-1') as the semantic and template authority that 'makes the vault legible as coordinate-bearing content rather than a loose pile of files' (S1.md). What S1 IS, definitionally, is the Bimba-Pratibimba materialisation: the position where canonical form and reflective instance 'are materially differentiated without being torn apart — the file IS the thing, the canvas IS the process, the folder IS the context, and the link IS the relation' (S1.md). It is the manifestation of #1 Form within the technology stack: the layer where coordinate becomes durable, frontmatter-bearing, residency-lawed material.
properties.q_2_residency_and_legibility: S1 moves by RESIDING and by RENDERING-LEGIBLE — its native act is to give every artifact a lawful home and a graph-readable identity. The operations are explicit (S1.md): filesystem residency and folder law, frontmatter-bearing note identity, template-born artifact instantiation, wikilink and backlink persistence. S1 couples in two directions along the stack. Downward it consumes S0: Khora actualises it 'as write-edge and path steward,' binding artifacts to real filesystem paths. Upward it provisions S2: 'S2' receives its node and edge legibility from what S1 has already made materially explicit' (S1.md) — the graph can only relate what the vault has first made into coordinate-bearing, frontmatter-typed material. Its prime augmentation Hen (S1') carries the lawful compiler/residency spine: the four-seam pattern (hook → append-safe ledger → compile/enrich → inject/promote) in its canonical residency-gating form (S-SYSTEM-INDEX). Chronos consumes S1 as the temporal homebase of Day and NOW; Anima and the constitutional agents inhabit it as bounded runtime context. The relation S1 enacts is materialisation-as-legibility: it does not merely store notes, it disciplines stored text into the typed, linked, resident form that every higher graph-, temporal-, and agent-facing concern presupposes. The frontmatter is the typing-act; the wikilink is the relation-act; the residency law is the home-act.
properties.q_3_torus_residency_law: S1's organising structure is the TORUS — the live node carries this topology, and it is apt: the torus is the primary workflow, the 'cyclical, self-enclosing processual loop' (CLAUDE.md II.D), and S1's residency law IS a closed promotion loop. The cycle is explicit (S1.md, #0 Ground): the promotion path from Seeds to Types to World, the MOC topology of the ordered mirror, and the return of homebase temporal files to their canonical template ground. Structurally this is the 4+2 made into vault law: a form is seeded, refined in the World/Types MOC workspace, graduated flat to World, invoked into Present (Day/NOW), reflected into Pratibimba, and sedimented back as new canonical ground — the loop closing on itself. Its inner sixfold articulates the torus (S1.md): S1.0 filesystem ground, S1.1 frontmatter structure, S1.2 template operations, S1.3 world patterns and promotion flow, S1.4 context frames and type-local organisation, S1.5 wikilink integration and graph legibility. The hard structural laws that hold the torus non-degenerate (S1.md): no /Forms branch (canonical forms are flat in World); no confusion between Form and Type (the flat file and the indexed folder-canvas pair serve different ontological roles); no runtime artifact without residency, lineage, and coordinate-bearing identity. The pattern is therefore not a flat directory but a self-enclosing circulation: material that flows from seed to canon to invocation to reflection and back to ground, the vault as a torus whose surface every artifact must traverse.
properties.q_4_durable_vault_law: S1 exists to give Epi-Logos a DURABLE BODY — 'the material container of Epi-Logos: the human-readable vault where Bimba forms, Type mirrors, and temporal Pratibimba artifacts become durable markdown memory' (S1.md p1_definition). Its telos is residency-as-law: so that meaning does not merely run (S0) but PERSISTS in a form that carries its own coordinate, lineage, and home. Its genealogy is the second manifestation within the S-family — #1 (raw archetype Definition/Form) → S1 (Obsidian/Material Container), the descent of Form into the technology stack as portable, frontmatter-bearing markdown. Its locality in the S-SYSTEM-INDEX system image is precise: 'S1 makes it resident and typed in the vault' — the layer whose primary data authority is vault residency, artifact form, CT templates, and the graduation path (S-SYSTEM-INDEX Level Map). It carries the residency law that the World/Types/Empty/Pratibimba distinction encodes (CLAUDE.md II.C): canon flat in World, ordered MOCs in Types, active invocation in Empty/Present, reflective afterlife in Pratibimba. Read teleologically, S1 is why the system has a memory that is legible to itself rather than a heap of files: every artifact 'must converge toward' the residency law, and 'deviations from this law are non-canonical' (S1.md). Purpose: to be the material homebase where the whole map becomes durable, typed, linked, and findable.
properties.q_5_seed_to_world_return: S1 closes by being a circuit that returns material to canonical ground. The return is the promotion loop itself (S1.md): runtime artifacts flow into Pratibimba's reflective afterlife, and what crystallises 'becomes canonical meaning' graduated flat to World — that is, becomes new Bimba ground for the next cycle. This is the matheme's 5→0 read as vault law: the temporal Pratibimba (the achieved reflection, the 1/0) folds back into the canonical Form (the standing source, the 0/1), the two joined by the twist 5→0 that turns this session's reflection into next session's canon. S1 thus materialises the standing identity 0/1 + 1/0 = 1/1 at the level of memory: Bimba (canonical form, descent-face) and Pratibimba (reflective instance, ascent-face) are 'materially differentiated without being torn apart' (S1.md) — one body read from its two faces, the flat World file and its temporal reflection joined by the graduation that makes the reflection become ground. And S1 OPENS rather than concludes because tomorrow's canon is always more than today's: each promotion deposits a form enriched by everything its invocation and reflection carried back — the vault grows, the MOC topology thickens, new coordinate-bearing material settles into World. The epogdoon η = log(9/8) keeps it one whole-tone short of closure (kernel-spec §0): no form is ever finally crystallised, each Seeds→Types→World return grounds a vault slightly richer than the one before. S1 is the body that is never finished being made durable — the residency circuit that re-opens, enriched, every cycle.
